branches.label: structured Lorentz-invariant quantum vacuum
branches.carrier: quantum fields and their ground or thermal state
branches.signature: no substrate-specific signature without an added record law
branches.killTest: not applicable as a generic framework; particular ontology compiles out if it changes no record

branches.label: dynamical timelike vector or Einstein-aether
branches.carrier: unit timelike vector coupled to the metric
branches.requiredRecovery: stable luminal tensor sector, acceptable post-Newtonian limit and cosmology
branches.signature: extra modes, dipole radiation, strong-field sensitivities or preferred-frame coefficients
branches.killTest: no stable coupling region survives joined pulsar, gravitational-wave, cosmological and local bounds

branches.label: khronon or preferred foliation
branches.carrier: scalar-defined spacelike foliation with higher-spatial-derivative dynamics
branches.requiredRecovery: healthy infrared gravity and controlled ultraviolet completion
branches.signature: dispersion, universal horizons, altered compact objects or preferred-frame gravity
branches.killTest: strong coupling, instability or absence of a matched viable trajectory

branches.label: emergent Lorentz symmetry from nonrelativistic microphysics
branches.carrier: microscopic many-body or relational degrees of freedom
branches.requiredRecovery: one radiatively stable cone for all observed sectors
branches.signature: controlled high-energy dispersion, cone splitting, defects or substrate noise
branches.killTest: universal low-energy cone requires repeated species-by-species fine tuning

branches.label: analogue spacetime in a known medium
branches.carrier: condensate, fluid, optical or mechanical medium
branches.requiredRecovery: effective metric and dispersion derived from measured medium dynamics
branches.signature: horizons, mode conversion, cutoff dispersion and backreaction
branches.killTest: inference cannot recover held-out medium parameters or confuses analogy with cosmic identity

branches.label: Lorentz-compatible discrete or relational substrate
branches.carrier: causal order, graph, tensor or other pregeometric relation
branches.requiredRecovery: continuum dimension, locality, metric, matter and dynamics
branches.signature: scale-dependent locality, dispersion, stochasticity or topological scars
branches.killTest: continuum limit fails or all proposed scars are discretization artifacts

branches.label: dark condensate or superfluid sector
branches.carrier: new dark-sector matter with collective phases
branches.requiredRecovery: cosmology, lensing, structure formation and local gravity
branches.signature: phase-dependent galactic force, phonons, vortices or merger behaviour
branches.killTest: one parameter set cannot fit independent galactic, cluster and cosmological records

frontiers.label: universal-cone convergence
frontiers.question: Which symmetry or renormalization flow makes every observed species share one infrared causal metric?
frontiers.nextGate: construct and stress-test a multi-species flow through symmetry breaking
frontiers.stopRule: cone equality is separately imposed or is radiatively unstable

frontiers.label: substrate susceptibility-noise relation
frontiers.question: What noise, dissipation or memory must accompany the carrier response?
frontiers.nextGate: derive response and noise from one action and propagate both to a calibrated detector
frontiers.stopRule: the carrier couples strongly enough to generate the effect but its compulsory noise is excluded

frontiers.label: cross-sector preferred-direction fit
frontiers.question: Does one direction and coefficient relation survive photon, matter, neutrino and gravity detectors?
frontiers.nextGate: hierarchical fit with local nuisance models and held-out epochs
frontiers.stopRule: directions or coefficients fail to transfer across sectors

frontiers.label: compact-object extra-mode spectroscopy
frontiers.question: Do scalar or vector carrier modes leave dipole, polarization, lensing or ringdown records?
frontiers.nextGate: join pulsar timing and waveform predictions for one frozen action
frontiers.stopRule: viable parameters make every extra mode observationally and radiatively inert

frontiers.label: analogue emergence inverse problem
frontiers.question: Can the background, cone, cutoff and backreaction be recovered blindly from response data?
frontiers.nextGate: run a held-out BEC or metamaterial recovery benchmark
frontiers.stopRule: multiple inequivalent media remain detector-equivalent under the declared records

frontiers.label: Casimir orientation and boost residual
frontiers.question: Does a substrate predict a residual beyond material-complete Lifshitz response?
frontiers.nextGate: derive a no-refit rotation, boost, temperature and distance law before measurement
frontiers.stopRule: patch, geometry and dielectric nuisances span the residual or no substrate law is supplied

frontiers.label: defect-to-particle derivation
frontiers.question: Can substrate defects derive particle charge, inertia, statistics and interaction?
frontiers.nextGate: construct one stable defect family and compute a held-out interaction
frontiers.stopRule: defect language reproduces labels but not spectra or couplings

frontiers.label: thermal preferred-frame transport
frontiers.question: Does a timelike carrier alter equilibrium or nonequilibrium heat transport consistently with gravity?
frontiers.nextGate: derive the covariant transport tensor and its laboratory modulation
frontiers.stopRule: the effect reduces to ordinary anisotropic material transport or violates equilibrium consistency
